title: Geekvape Soul 2 Pod Vape Kit
description: The Geekvape Soul 2 Pod Vape Kit is a feature-rich, versatile device built to offer both simplicity and control. Combining a powerful 2100mAh battery with up to 35W of output, it’s ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) and RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) vaping alike. This upgraded pod kit features Smart Mode, which automatically adjusts power output to suit your pod’s resistance, as well as full manual control for custom wattage settings. You can choose between inhale or button activation, and a hidden 0.99” OLED screen gives access to vaping data including battery level, wattage, resistance, puff count and more. Each kit includes two top-fill Soul 2 pods with built-in mesh coils – one 0.6ohm and one 1.0ohm – making it easy to get started with either a warmer RDL vape or a cooler, tighter MTL inhale. The device is also compatible with a 0.4ohm pod (sold separately) for a looser DTL draw. A simple airflow slider on the side allows you to adjust the draw to your preference. The Soul 2’s leak-resistant pod design and quick 40-minute USB-C charging mean it’s built for everyday reliability. With elegant styling and performance to match, this device is a solid upgrade for vapers who want the best of both convenience and control. Browse our vape juice and find the perfect flavour to match this kit. We recommend using High PG , 50/50 or Nic Salts with this kit. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Pods, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming' simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
